To raise money for Pieta, I independently organised and ran a month-long bake sale throughout October, donating **70% of the profits** to the charity.

Although September is recognised as Suicide Awareness Month, I believe suicide prevention and mental health awareness are issues that deserve attention all year round. This inspired me to run the fundraiser throughout October and encourage continued conversation and support.

I independently managed every aspect of the fundraiser, from planning and promoting the bake sale to **managing customer orders, preparing and baking all products, and tracking sales, expenses and donations**.

The fundraiser was a huge success. Customers enjoyed a variety of homemade treats, and together we were able to make a meaningful contribution to Pieta.

**In total, I raised €755.35 for Pieta.** Of this, €675.35 was raised through the bake sale and additional donations collected, with a further €80 donated directly through my iDonate fundraising page.

```{=html}
<script>
let dogCurrent = 0;
const dogTotal = 6;
function moveCarousel(dir) {
  dogCurrent = (dogCurrent + dir + dogTotal) % dogTotal;
  updateCarousel();
}
function goToSlide(index) {
  dogCurrent = index;
  updateCarousel();
}
function updateCarousel() {
  document.getElementById('dogCarousel').style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (dogCurrent * 100) + '%)';
  document.querySelectorAll('.dot').forEach(function(dot, i) {
    dot.style.opacity = i === dogCurrent ? '1' : '0.6';
  });
}
</script>
```
